iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ISTATS
       Namespace ISTATS

DESCRIPTION
       The iStats commands allow you to interact with the powerful new (as of v11.0.0) stats interface available within BIG-IP.
	 * Users can create an arbitrary number of iStats (although there is a practical limit of 5,000-10,000 iStats)
	 * iStats do not have to be preconfigured or predefined, they can be built on the fly, effectively
	 * Any consumer of iStats (even iRules) will always get the global view (meaning, not on a per-TMM basis, but rather
       aggregated over all stat producers)
	 * iStats can be both read and modified by the control plane, i.e. tmsh

HINTS
SEE ALSO
BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
